mapper.select:
SELECT t.type, IFNULL(ROUND((t.end_year_area - t.start_year_area) / 10000, 2), 0) AS areaDiff, IFNULL(ROUND((t.end_year_area - t.start_year_area) / IFNULL(t.start_year_area, t.end_year_area), 4), 0) AS areaRate FROM ( SELECT `type`, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN coverage_year = #{param.endTime} THEN coverage_area ELSE 0 END), 0) AS end_year_area, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN coverage_year = #{param.startTime} THEN coverage_area ELSE 0 END), 0) AS start_year_area FROM coverage_info
GROUP BY `type` ) t WHERE t.end_year_area IS NOT NULL AND t.start_year_area IS NOT NULL order by ABS(areaDiff) desc

select t.type, IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(t.coverage_area) / 10000, 2), 0) AS allArea, sum(t.count1) AS plaqueCount, IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(t.coverage_area) / 10000 / COUNT(t.count1), 4), 0) AS avgArea from ( SELECT ci.*, COUNT(cia.coverage_id) count1 FROM coverage_info ci LEFT JOIN coverage_info_area cia ON ci.id = cia.coverage_id
GROUP BY ci.id ) t group by t.type

SELECT cia.status, IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(cia.coverage_area) / 666.67, 2), 0) AS allArea, IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(cia.coverage_area) / (SELECT SUM(ci.coverage_area) FROM coverage_info ci WHERE ci.type = #{param.type} AND ci.coverage_type = #{param.coverageType} AND ci.coverage_year = #{param.startTime}), 4), 0) AS areaRate FROM coverage_info_area cia INNER JOIN coverage_info ci ON cia.coverage_id = ci.id
GROUP BY cia.status ORDER BY cia.status;
SELECT IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(coverage_area) / 666.67, 2), 0) AS allArea FROM coverage_info

SELECT coverage_year AS coverageYear, IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(coverage_area) / 666.67, 2), 0) AS allArea FROM coverage_info
GROUP BY coverage_year order BY coverage_year desc limit 5

SELECT ci.coverage_year AS coverageYear, IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(ci.coverage_area) / 666.67, 2), 0) AS allArea, IFNULL(COUNT(cia.coverage_id), 0) AS plaqueCount FROM coverage_info ci LEFT JOIN coverage_info_area cia ON ci.id = cia.coverage_id
GROUP BY ci.coverage_year order by ci.coverage_year desc limit 5
